title: 腫瘤醫學
intro: 癌症分期、化學／標靶／免疫治療與精準醫療。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Cancer staging, chemotherapy, targeted and immune therapy and precision oncology. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 影像與病理說不同故事
procedures.titleEn: When imaging and pathology tell different stories
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：63 歲女性肺部腫塊切片報告與影像分布不一致，轉診資料來自兩院。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 63-year-old woman has discordant lung-mass pathology and imaging from two hospitals.

stages.title: 先核對資料身分
stages.evidence: 影像報告寫右上肺，病理申請單只寫肺部組織。
stages.evidenceEn: Imaging specifies the right upper lung; pathology labels only lung tissue.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 核對病人與檢體來源
choices.en: Verify patient identity and specimen source

choices.zh: 選看起來更嚴重的報告當正確
choices.en: Choose whichever report sounds worse

choices.zh: 直接假設病理醫師出錯
choices.en: Assume the pathologist made an error

stages.reason: 資料對應正確才有意義。
stages.reasonEn: Interpretation requires correctly matched data.
stages.pitfall: 錯配部位會使後續決策失準。

stages.title: 檢體代表性
stages.evidence: 切片很小且壞死多，報告註記判讀受限。
stages.evidenceEn: The biopsy is small and largely necrotic, with limited interpretation noted.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 不管限制直接選療程
choices.en: Choose treatment while ignoring limitations

choices.zh: 把限制帶入多專科複核
choices.en: Bring limitations to multidisciplinary review

choices.zh: 受限報告等於確定沒有癌症
choices.en: A limited report proves no cancer

stages.reason: 檢體可能沒有代表整個病灶。
stages.reasonEn: A sample may not represent the whole lesion.
stages.pitfall: 將受限誤當陰性容易造成錯誤安心。
stages.pitfallEn: Calling a limited result negative falsely reassures.

stages.title: 決定下一個問題
stages.evidence: 團隊提出再次採樣或補充染色，病人擔心重做。
stages.evidenceEn: The team discusses repeat sampling or additional stains; she worries about repetition.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 只說多做總比少做好
choices.en: Say more testing is always better

choices.zh: 保證補做一定得到答案
choices.en: Guarantee every additional test gives an answer

choices.zh: 說明補查目的與負擔
choices.en: Explain further-testing aims and burdens

stages.reason: 檢查價值在於能否減少關鍵不確定性。
stages.reasonEn: Testing matters when it reduces key uncertainty.
stages.pitfall: 沒有目的的檢查增加負擔。

stages.title: 暫定結論要可追蹤
stages.evidence: 會議先記錄最可能分類，但保留待確認項目。
stages.evidenceEn: The meeting records a likely category with unresolved items.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 清楚標示暫定與確認資訊
choices.en: Label provisional and confirmed findings clearly

choices.zh: 刪除所有不確定字樣
choices.en: Remove all uncertainty wording

choices.zh: 不同報告混成一個肯定句
choices.en: Merge discordant reports into a certainty

stages.reason: 交班需保留證據狀態。
stages.reasonEn: Handover must preserve evidence status.
stages.pitfall: 過度肯定可能使下一團隊跳過複核。
stages.pitfallEn: Overconfidence can make the next team skip review.

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班影像部位、採樣對應、檢體限制、會議暫定結論與待辦負責人。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover imaging site, sampling match, limitations, provisional conclusions and task owners.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

choices.zh: 交接證據、疑問與追蹤責任
choices.en: Hand over evidence, open questions and follow-up ownership

choices.zh: 只記錄最後一個檢驗值，省略症狀變化
choices.en: Record only the latest result, omitting symptom changes

stages.reason: 將本案時間線與尚待核對的證據交給接手者，才能延續安全決策。
stages.reasonEn: The timeline and unresolved evidence allow the next team to continue safe decisions.
stages.pitfall: 未交代本案待辦與責任歸屬，異常結果可能無人追蹤。
stages.pitfallEn: Without pending tasks and ownership, abnormal results may go unreviewed.

procedures.learningBoundary: 辨識、解釋、風險分層與交班練習；不提供真人處置劑量或操作參數。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Recognition, interpretation, risk reasoning and handover; no treatment doses or operational parameters.

procedures.title: 「未檢出」和「無法判讀」不同
procedures.titleEn: Not detected is not the same as uninterpretable
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：54 歲男性新診斷肺癌，腫瘤檢測表格有數項空白。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 54-year-old man with newly diagnosed lung cancer has several blank tumour-test fields.

stations.en: Ask what additional testing could change
Avoid treating a marker as a guarantee

stations.zh: 腫瘤檢測與遺傳不是同一件事
stations.en: Tumour testing is not identical to inherited testing

stages.title: 讀清楚報告用語
stages.evidence: 報告註明腫瘤細胞量不足，並非所有標記都成功分析。
stages.evidenceEn: The report notes insufficient tumour content; not all markers were analysed.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 把空白當所有標記陽性
choices.en: Treat every blank as positive

choices.zh: 區分陰性與未完成
choices.en: Distinguish negative from incomplete testing

choices.zh: 把所有空白當陰性
choices.en: Treat every blank as negative

stages.reason: 檢測品質決定結論可否成立。
stages.reasonEn: Test quality determines what conclusions are valid.
stages.pitfall: 誤讀空白會錯誤縮窄選項。
stages.pitfallEn: Misreading blanks can exclude options incorrectly.

stages.title: 詢問補充檢測的用途
stages.titleEn: Ask what additional testing could change
stages.evidence: 病理團隊可評估剩餘組織是否足夠。
stages.evidenceEn: Pathology can assess whether remaining tissue is adequate.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 不看材料直接重送相同檢體
choices.en: Resubmit the same specimen without review

choices.zh: 要求一次檢查保證涵蓋未來所有藥物
choices.en: Demand one test cover every future drug

choices.zh: 先確認材料與會改變的臨床決策
choices.en: Check material and the decision testing may change

stages.reason: 適當問題與材料比盲目重送重要。
stages.reasonEn: A suitable question and material matter more than repetition.
stages.pitfall: 反覆失敗會消耗檢體與時間。
stages.pitfallEn: Repeated failure consumes tissue and time.

stages.title: 避免把標記當保證
stages.titleEn: Avoid treating a marker as a guarantee
stages.evidence: 補充結果發現可討論的變異，病人問是否一定有效。
stages.evidenceEn: Further testing finds a potentially relevant variant; he asks whether treatment must work.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 釐清適用條件與限制
choices.en: Clarify applicability and limitations

choices.zh: 有變異就保證治癒
choices.en: A variant guarantees cure

choices.zh: 所有變異都沒有臨床用途
choices.en: No variant has clinical use

stages.reason: 標記可以協助選擇，不能保證個別反應。
stages.reasonEn: Markers guide selection but cannot guarantee response.
stages.pitfall: 絕對承諾破壞知情選擇。

stages.title: 腫瘤檢測與遺傳不是同一件事
stages.titleEn: Tumour testing is not identical to inherited testing
stages.evidence: 家屬問腫瘤變異是否表示子女一定遺傳。
stages.evidenceEn: Family asks whether the tumour variant must be inherited by children.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 未經同意立即通知子女已帶因
choices.en: Tell children they are carriers without consent

choices.zh: 視結果與病史判斷遺傳諮詢需求
choices.en: Assess counselling needs using the result and history

choices.zh: 所有腫瘤變異都是遺傳的
choices.en: Every tumour variant is inherited

stages.reason: 體細胞與生殖系結果需要區分。
stages.reasonEn: Somatic and germline findings differ.
stages.pitfall: 誤傳遺傳結論會增加不必要焦慮。

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班成功與失敗的檢測項目、檢體限制、變異證據及諮詢需求。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover completed/failed tests, specimen limits, variant evidence and counselling needs.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 只記錄最後一個檢驗值，省略症狀變化
choices.en: Record only the latest result, omitting symptom changes

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

choices.zh: 交接證據、疑問與追蹤責任
choices.en: Hand over evidence, open questions and follow-up ownership

stages.reason: 將本案時間線與尚待核對的證據交給接手者，才能延續安全決策。
stages.reasonEn: The timeline and unresolved evidence allow the next team to continue safe decisions.
stages.pitfall: 未交代本案待辦與責任歸屬，異常結果可能無人追蹤。
stages.pitfallEn: Without pending tasks and ownership, abnormal results may go unreviewed.

procedures.learningBoundary: 辨識、解釋、風險分層與交班練習；不提供真人處置劑量或操作參數。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Recognition, interpretation, risk reasoning and handover; no treatment doses or operational parameters.

procedures.title: 腫瘤報告上的 BRCA 與家族問題
procedures.titleEn: BRCA on a tumour report and family questions
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：45 歲女性卵巢癌檢測發現 BRCA 相關變異，妹妹希望立即得知自己的風險。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 45-year-old woman’s ovarian tumour has a BRCA-related variant; her sister asks about her own risk.

stations.zh: 取得病人的選擇與同意

stages.title: 先分辨檢體來源
stages.evidence: 目前結果來自腫瘤組織，尚無確認的生殖系報告。
stages.evidenceEn: The finding comes from tumour tissue without a confirmed germline report.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 直接宣布全家均帶因
choices.en: Declare the whole family carriers

choices.zh: 因是腫瘤檢體就排除遺傳可能
choices.en: Exclude inherited risk because tissue was tested

choices.zh: 區分腫瘤與遺傳結果
choices.en: Distinguish tumour and inherited findings

stages.reason: 檢體來源限制了可回答的問題。
stages.reasonEn: Specimen source limits the question answered.
stages.pitfall: 混淆檢體會造成家族誤判。

stages.title: 取得病人的選擇與同意
stages.evidence: 病人願意了解，但暫時不想讓所有親屬知道。
stages.evidenceEn: She wants information but does not want every relative informed yet.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 安排遺傳諮詢並討論資訊分享
choices.en: Arrange counselling and discuss information sharing

choices.zh: 繞過本人直接傳送報告給親屬
choices.en: Send the report to relatives without her consent

choices.zh: 拒絕任何遺傳討論
choices.en: Refuse all genetic discussion

stages.reason: 諮詢包含醫學資訊與隱私選擇。
stages.reasonEn: Counselling includes information and privacy choices.
stages.pitfall: 未經同意分享會損害信任。

stages.title: 不確定變異的意義
stages.evidence: 另一項結果被標為意義未明變異。
stages.evidenceEn: Another finding is labelled a variant of uncertain significance.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 把未明變異當絕對正常
choices.en: Treat uncertainty as certainly benign

choices.zh: 保留未明分類待專評
choices.en: Retain uncertain classification for expert review

choices.zh: 把未明變異當確定致病
choices.en: Treat uncertainty as proven pathogenicity

stages.reason: 未知不是肯定或否定的同義詞。
stages.reasonEn: Unknown is neither definitely harmful nor harmless.
stages.pitfall: 錯誤分類可能影響重大決策。

stages.title: 追蹤資訊可能改變
stages.evidence: 病人詢問若變異解讀日後更新，誰會通知。
stages.evidenceEn: She asks who will notify her if variant interpretation changes.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 保證分類永遠不變
choices.en: Guarantee classification never changes

choices.zh: 要求病人每天自行搜尋
choices.en: Require daily self-searching

choices.zh: 確認追蹤機制與聯絡資料
choices.en: Clarify follow-up arrangements and contact details

stages.reason: 建立可執行的追蹤比抽象保證有用。
stages.reasonEn: Feasible follow-up is better than abstract reassurance.
stages.pitfall: 沒有責任分工容易錯過更新。

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班腫瘤與生殖系檢測狀態、變異分類、病人同意範圍及諮詢追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover tumour/germline status, variant classification, consent scope and counselling follow-up.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 交接證據、疑問與追蹤責任
choices.en: Hand over evidence, open questions and follow-up ownership

choices.zh: 只記錄最後一個檢驗值，省略症狀變化
choices.en: Record only the latest result, omitting symptom changes

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

stages.reason: 將本案時間線與尚待核對的證據交給接手者，才能延續安全決策。
stages.reasonEn: The timeline and unresolved evidence allow the next team to continue safe decisions.
stages.pitfall: 未交代本案待辦與責任歸屬，異常結果可能無人追蹤。
stages.pitfallEn: Without pending tasks and ownership, abnormal results may go unreviewed.

procedures.learningBoundary: 辨識、解釋、風險分層與交班練習；不提供真人處置劑量或操作參數。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Recognition, interpretation, risk reasoning and handover; no treatment doses or operational parameters.

procedures.title: 分期、分級與淋巴結：三個不同問題
procedures.titleEn: Stage, grade and nodes: three different questions
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：60 歲男性大腸腫瘤術後讀到「高分級」和「區域淋巴結」，以為都代表遠端轉移。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 60-year-old man reads high grade and regional nodes after colorectal surgery and assumes distant spread.

stations.zh: N 與 M 的意義

stages.title: 先釐清名詞
stages.evidence: 病理分級描述細胞特徵；分期描述疾病範圍。
stages.evidenceEn: Grade describes cellular features; stage describes disease extent.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 分別解釋分級與分期
choices.en: Explain grade and stage separately

choices.zh: 高分級等於第四期
choices.en: High grade always means stage IV

choices.zh: 分級與分期永遠相同
choices.en: Grade and stage are identical

stages.reason: 兩個分類描述不同面向。
stages.reasonEn: The classifications describe different dimensions.
stages.pitfall: 名詞混淆會造成不必要恐慌。

stages.title: N 與 M 的意義
stages.evidence: 報告提到區域淋巴結，遠端影像仍在評估。
stages.evidenceEn: Regional nodes are reported; distant imaging is still being assessed.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 淋巴結資訊完全不影響分期
choices.en: Nodes never affect staging

choices.zh: 區分區域與遠端轉移
choices.en: Distinguish regional from distant spread

choices.zh: 任何淋巴結都代表遠端轉移
choices.en: Every node represents distant metastasis

stages.reason: 淋巴結與遠端病灶在系統中分別描述。
stages.reasonEn: Nodes and distant lesions are described separately.
stages.pitfall: 錯讀字母會改變病人對療程的理解。

stages.title: 確認使用哪一份資料
stages.evidence: 有術前影像分期與術後病理資料。
stages.evidenceEn: Preoperative imaging stage and postoperative pathology are both available.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 刪除舊報告使兩者看起來相同
choices.en: Delete older reports to make them agree

choices.zh: 任選較低的一個數字
choices.en: Choose whichever number is lower

choices.zh: 標記臨床與病理資料及其時間
choices.en: Label clinical/pathological evidence and timing

stages.reason: 不同時點與方法可能補充資訊。
stages.reasonEn: Different times and methods add information.
stages.pitfall: 去除來源會失去判讀脈絡。

stages.title: 用回述確認理解
stages.evidence: 病人能說出「高分級」，仍說所有淋巴結都是末期。
stages.evidenceEn: He repeats high grade but still calls every node terminal disease.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 請他用自己的話重述，再修正混淆
choices.en: Ask for his explanation and address the confusion

choices.zh: 只重複同一句專有名詞
choices.en: Repeat the jargon unchanged

choices.zh: 把理解問題當不配合
choices.en: Treat misunderstanding as non-cooperation

stages.reason: 回述能找出尚未釐清的概念。
stages.reasonEn: Teach-back reveals unresolved concepts.
stages.pitfall: 只問懂不懂容易錯估理解。
stages.pitfallEn: A yes/no understanding question can mislead.

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班分級、臨床與病理分期資訊、遠端評估待辦及病人仍有的疑問。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover grade, clinical/pathological staging, pending distant assessment and remaining questions.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
